docs.summary: Auditions a clip from the inspector, outside play mode.
docs.remarks: Driven straight off the native source rather than through an AudioSource, because component lifecycle callbacks are gated to play mode, so an AudioSource placed in the editor would never create anything to play with. One voice, so starting a preview replaces the one before it.

docs.summary: The clip currently being auditioned, or Guid.Empty.
Whether a clip is currently being auditioned. Checks the native audio source state.
Starts auditioning a clip, replacing whatever was playing.
Stops the audition, if one is playing.
